scope.work: Three reviewed literal reference outputs and independent grader checks only; no generation, holdouts, candidate trials, qualification, or admission.

checks: Review, runner, source, and all 137 runtime dependency hashes match the supplied exact digests.
The reviewed output schema caps document_b64 at 200000 characters; the preparation placeholder is therefore a conservative upper bound for grader batching.
Each call uses the existing authorize/reserve path for one operation and timeout plus five seconds; deterministic operation IDs and the exclusive started marker refuse blind replay.
The runner invokes only the reference and grader; it does not invoke the generator or any model-facing service.
reviewer_note: The read-only SQLite counter query opened the WAL database and created an empty aeep.sqlite3-wal and 32 KiB aeep.sqlite3-shm sidecar. They were left in place; the main database file was unchanged.
